notes: COMPLETED means the run finished without a fatal process failure. It does NOT by itself mean the hypothesis was scientifically supported.
INCONCLUSIVE is a first-class run outcome, distinct from FAILED (a raw run/process failure) and distinct from a scientific PASS/FAIL verdict.
Scientific verdicts (e.g. a hypothesis supported/falsified) are recorded separately, in an experiment's own analysis output, never inferred from the state machine or from a process exit code alone.
